objective: Independent competent MPPI acquisition, candidate-owned actor learning, then measured useful global feedback into independent local search

budget_this_stage.allowed: Read existing evidence, verify live handles, implement and test ownership/configuration guards with synthetic evaluators only
budget_this_stage.existing_remote_computation: Reuse and report separately; do not restart or duplicate pending qualification

gates: Fresh complete K256/H48 qualification passes with all failures and costs retained; raw reproducible acquisition is separately required
Every score that ranks/proposes/accepts actor changes has explicit complete candidate ownership and finite absorbing fall cost
Predeclared bounded actual-Walker diagnostic shows repeatable complete-return improvement with meaningful bounded parameter perturbations
Learning from independently reached states transfers to ordinary starts on root-disjoint panels
Competent frozen actor continuations improve rankings and executed independent closed-loop search at matched proposals and charged costs

standalone_walking.final_reset_panels: Must be frozen and untouched by later learning diagnostics; no new final panel is consumed in this stage

stopping.pending_qualification: Verified wait; collect no new simulator experience
stopping.qualification_failure: Stop before actor learning; preserve negative result
stopping.missing_raw_acquisition: Do not promote summaries to guide snapshots; predeclare and charge minimal recovery before use
stopping.ownership_or_accounting_failure: Stop and preserve attempted work; never silently fall back to a base-policy surrogate
stopping.no_repeatable_learning_signal: Stop without larger campaign or final-result retuning
stopping.follow_on_learning_protocol: Prepare only after the bounded Walker diagnostic supports it; do not automatically launch a campaign
